items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: That was Celestine, William Racely, John Marrero, Simon Marrero, Paul Barnes, and Williton... engaged us to play in the airplane.

ctx.x: That went to Fort Worth. Paul Barnes, saxophone. Chinese, drummer. John Marrero, banjo. Simon Marrero, bass. Celestine, cornet. William Ridgely, trombone. Emma Barrett, saxophone. Piano.

items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: I've seen him in the street, but I never did know him.

ctx.x: They always did know them to do it.
Here's a picture. That's Paul Barnes.
